corePassives.description: Many of Szayelaporro's attacks summon his Fracciones to attack. After attacking, these Fracciones turn into Sacrificial Materials on the field. Szayelaporro can detonate them using a Special Attack to grant teammates stacks of Intel Control. Each stack increases Spirit Mastery by 0.4% for 20 seconds, up to 6 stacks. When entering Resurreccion, Szayelaporro grants all Spirit characters 1 stack of Sample Analysis. Whenever an on-field character with Sample Analysis deals damage, all Spirit characters gain 1 additional stack of Sample Analysis. Each stack increases their Crit DMG by 0.5% for 30 seconds, stacking up to 30 times. When the team includes 1/2 Spirit characters other than Szayelaporro, the buff effects provided by Intel Control, Sample Analysis, and the passives Research Expert, Backstage Monitoring, and Corridor Modification are increased to 2/4 times their original values.
corePassives.name: Miserable End

corePassives.description: Each time Szayelaporro releases a technique or counterattack, the entire team's ATK increases by 10% for 20 seconds.
corePassives.name: Research Expert

corePassives.description: At the start of battle, if Szayelaporro's ATK is higher than 3280, every additional 500 ATK increases the effect of Intel Control by 0.15%, up to 0.6%.
corePassives.name: Backstage Monitoring

corePassives.description: At the start of battle, if Szayelaporro's Crit DMG is higher than 75, every additional 25 Crit DMG increases the effect of Sample Analysis by 0.25%, up to 1%.
corePassives.name: Corridor Modification
